translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: «Hintte giddon timbbitiyaa odiyaawe woy akumuwaa biliyaa Asay denddiide, malaataanne maalalissiyaabaa ootsooppe,
I odeedda malaatay woy maalalissiyaabay tumu gidiide polettina, I hinttena, ‹Ane kase hintte erenna hara s'oossatoo goyinnoytte› yaagooppe,
hintte Aa mulekka sisoppite. Hintte Aa kumentsaa wozanaappenne kumentsaa shemppuwaappe Med'inaa Godaa hintte S'oossaa dosinttonne giide, hinttena I paac'c'anaw hewaa ootsee.
Med'inaa Godaa hintte S'oossaa kaallite; aw yayyite; Aa azazuwaa naagite; Aa k'aalaakka sisite; aw goyinnite; aappe duus's'oppite.

Hinttena Gibs'eppe kessiide, ayiletetsaappe hinttena wozeedda Med'inaa Godaa hintte S'oossaa bolla hintte makkalanaadan tamaarissiyaa timbbitiyaa odiyaawaa, woy akumuwaa biliyaawaa wod'ite; hewaa mala Asay hinttena Med'inaa Godaa hintte S'oossaa azazuwaappe wora baanaadan ootsiyaa diraw, hewaa malaa wod'iide, iitaa hintte giddoppe diggite.

«Haray atto ne daay na'ay ne ishay, ne attumanne mac'c'a na'i, ne siik'iyaa ne machchata, woy ne siik'o laggii neena, ‹Dendda, kase neeninne ne mayzza aawotuu goyinni erenna s'oossaw goyinnana› gooppe,
biittaw ha gas'aappe ya gas'aa gakkanaw de'iyaa, ne yuushshuwaa ubbaan mataaninne haakuwaan de'iyaa Asay ubbay goyinniyaa s'oossatoo, ‹Dendda biide unttunttoo goyinnana› giide baletsooppe,
aw eeno gooppa; I giyaawaakka sisoppa. Aw k'arettaade Aa guyye ashshoppa;
Aa wod'anaw koshshee. Aa wod'anaw koyiro ne doomma; hewaappe guyyiyaan, Asay ubbay bare kushiyaa Aa bolla wotsiide wod'o.
I hayk'k'ana gakkanaw, shuchchaan c'addite; ayaw gooppe, I hinttena Gibs'e gadiyaappe, ayiletetsaa golliyaappe kesseedda Med'inaa Godaappe, hintte S'oossaappe, hinttena shaakkanaw koyeedda.
Israa'eeliyaa Asay ubbay hewaa sisiide yayana; k'ay hewaa mala iitabaakka laa"entso hintte giddon ooninne ootsenna.
«Med'inaa Goday hintte S'oossay hintte de'anaadan immiyaa katamaappe ittuwaan hintte de'iyaa wode,
hintte asaa giddon iitatuu denddiide, asaa, ‹Denddite! Biide hintte erenna s'oossatoo goyinnoytte› yaagiide baletsiyaawaa sisooppe,
he yewuwaabaa oochchite; minisiide paydite. K'orina he hintte giddon tunabay oosetteeddawe tuma gidooppe,
he kataman de'iyaa asaa ubbaa mashshaa k'aran wurssite; he katamaanne aan de'iyaa mehiyaannakka ashshenan d'ayissite.

He katamaappe hintte akkeedda omooduwaa ubbaa katamaa dabaabaa shiishshite. He katamaanne Aa omooduwaa ubbaa Med'inaa Godaw, hintte S'oossaw, s'uuggiyaa yarshshuwaa ootsiide wurssi s'uuggite. I med'inawukka laa"entso kees'ettenna; laaletteedda saa gidiide, he sa'ay attana.

Tuna geetetteedda miishshaappe ayaynne hintte kushiyan beettoppo. Yaatooppe, Med'inaa Goday bare wolk'k'aama hank'k'uwaappe simmiide, hinttena maarana; I hinttenttoo k'arettana. Kase hintte mayzza aawaatoo c'aak'k'eedda c'aak'uwaadan, hintte payduwaa darissana.

Ayaw gooppe, taani hachchi hinttena azaziyaa azazo ubbaa hintte naagiyaawaan Med'inaa Godaw, hintte S'oossaw azazettooppe, k'ay Med'inaa Godaa hintte S'oossaa sintsankka likke gidiyaabaa ootsooppe, he geeddawe hinttenttoo tumu polettana.
